turn.user_message: yes let us do the KPIs
turn.context: Eight measures, not eighteen. Six new, two already tracked and not expected to move. Three are early warnings. Nobody measures what nobody owns.

transcript.label: Transcript turn 29 · Part 5: What to measure

text: Eight numbers, checked weekly. Six of them nobody measures today.
bullets: Start with dead bed time. It moves when any of the others improve. Nothing in your hospital produces it today.
Three of the eight are early warnings. They show whether people are doing the new thing. If they slip, the rest follows within two weeks.
Weekly, not monthly. A month hides a bad week. Occupancy and length of stay stay as they are. This work is not meant to move them.
chat.pointer: Pick a dial to open it. Filter to the early warnings to see the three to watch first.
chat.invite: That is all five parts. Do you want a short summary, or shall we talk about a first step?
prompts: What would a first step look like?
Who would read these each week?

blocks.caption: Nobody measures what nobody owns. The two managers each own a set.

sheets.title: Dead bed time
sheets.text: The one number that moves when any of the others improve. Both halves already sit in your billing system. Only the link to the bed is missing.

lines.label: Data
lines.value: Bill close and bill open, against the bed

sheets.entry: Has anyone ever measured this at your hospital?

sheets.title: Time to a bed
sheets.text: From the patient arriving to the patient in a bed. Paperwork is the only step that cannot be made shorter.
sheets.entry: How do you time admissions now?

sheets.title: Beds mapped by the 6 PM freeze
sheets.text: Of tomorrow’s planned admissions, how many have a bed by 6 PM. If this slips, the call-in times slip next.
sheets.entry: How many planned admissions do you have on a usual day?

sheets.title: Discharge signals on time
sheets.text: How many discharges were signalled a full day ahead. This is the doctors’ part of the plan.
sheets.entry: How early do doctors say who goes home now?

sheets.title: Admissions finished by noon
sheets.text: How many of the day’s admissions are in a bed by noon, instead of 4:30 to 8 PM.
sheets.entry: What share is done by noon today?

sheets.title: 2 PM plans that hold
sheets.text: How many 2 PM mappings are still the same at the 6 PM freeze. It shows how good the first pass is.

sheets.title: Beds full
sheets.text: You track this already. It stays as it is. This work is not meant to raise it.

sheets.title: Average stay
sheets.text: You track this already. It may come down a little. That gain is counted once, inside the money.
